attribution: These quotes are originally from various sources throughought antiquity. I personally collected them from Latin Quips at Your Fingertips by Rose Williams

quotes.english: Anger is the one thing made better by delay.
quotes.latin: Rei nulli prodest mora nisi iracundiae.
quotes.name: Syrus

quotes.english: Am I to stand idel and unnoticed, so handsome and so heroic, all for nothing?
quotes.latin: Hic astabo tantisper cum hac forma et factis frustra?
quotes.name: Plautus

quotes.english: If you want to be loved, be lovable!
quotes.name: Ovid

quotes.english: For Heaven's sake, why are you and cheerfulness complete strangers?
quotes.latin: Quid, cedo, te obsecro tam abhorret hilaritudo?
quotes.name: Plautus

quotes.english: Some, through fear of death, prayed to die.
quotes.citation: Pliny the Younger, Epistula Cornelio Tacito
quotes.name: Pliny the Younger
